name: Irina → Liza-style

measuredVoice.character: young, bright, calm, friendly, clear Russian explainer delivery

targetStyle.goal: Bring Irina closer to Liza's youthful bright delivery while preserving Irina's identity and Russian clarity.

videoStyle.presenter: Liza on the left, persistent identity
videoStyle.background: dark navy/black technology UI with subtle grid and cyan accents
videoStyle.layout: presenter left; headline/idea center; cards, diagrams or waveform right
videoStyle.motion: restrained fade/slide/scale/line-draw, no random camera movement
videoStyle.audioOrder: voice first, then timing, then subtle ambience/SFX

rules: Do not claim Irina is the exact Liza voice; this is a prosody/style match.
Never substitute espeak or a system voice and call it Irina.
Use one continuous narration chunk when possible to avoid clicks and chopped pauses.
Keep speech intelligibility above music and SFX.
For short lessons, default to one 5-10 second sample before any longer render.
